title: Foraging Blacklist Violation Watch
dataSources: Catch trips (`outdoor:trip`), hunt map activity (`hunt:map`), foraging observations (`forage:observation`), smoker sessions (`cook:smoker`), harvest queues (`outdoor:queue`).
app: Fishing, hunting, foraging, and outdoor-cooking telemetry — Fishbrain catch logs, onX Hunt map exports, iNaturalist observations, and ThermoWorks smoker probes — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=forage:observation region=* restricted_species_flag=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(restricted_species_flag="yes",1,0))) as matched by region
| eval a_restricted_species_flag_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_restricted_species_flag_pct
description: Measures the percentage of foraging records that end with a restricted-species flag by region.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which region are helping or hurting foraging records.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a restricted-species flag` on `forage:observation` events and summarize the hit rate by `region`.
visualization: Table of region with percentage of foraging records ending with a restricted-species flag.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers how often a restricted-species flag happens for each region so you can see where foraging records go smoothly or get stuck.
